note: A screen, not an audit: questions worth asking and the data needed to answer them. No savings are computed; typical benefits are the cited sources' general wording.

questions.question: Are tank vapors vented to atmosphere with no vapor recovery?

evidence.text: equipment TK-A reads "TK-A TANK TO ATM"
no vapor recovery or blanket gas anywhere in the model

where: a walkdown: vent flow measurement and a gas sample
site records: tank throughput and product vapor pressure
data_requests.how: Estimate vented volume from throughput and breathing.

questions.decision_rule: Worth a VRU study when hydrocarbon vapor volume is steady and large.

typical_benefit.wording: "VRUs can recover over 95 percent of the hydrocarbon..." vapors; "payback in as little as two months" (partner experience).
source_titles: S20: EPA Natural Gas STAR Lessons Learned, Installing Vapor Recovery Units on Storage Tanks

questions.limits: The source also quotes a partner's annual dollar figure; it is deliberately not repeated.
